$Comment: Adds 500 to the Yeti's maximum health while his fight has at least 5 players in it: his fight's script applies it as he rises, one step per player up to 5, then refills him (Christmas_Yeti_Scale_TopUp), since a higher maximum leaves his current health where it was. It stays on him for the whole fight. Amount is the health one more player adds; change the four steps together.
